    THE HOLLOW MARCHES / YOUR STORYAn original adventure · · Original adventure

    At this table

    Astra is an open-world AI dungeon master. You can attempt any fictional action; the AI interprets the intent, but important mechanics are resolved by server code rather than invented by narration.

    • Write freely: negotiate, explore, travel, craft, fight, build relationships or pursue an entirely new goal. Suggestions are prompts, not limits.
    • The DM sets a check before the server rolls. Ability modifiers, background proficiency, advantage/disadvantage, criticals and attack damage are applied in code.
    • Your origin, background, backstory and personal goal stay in campaign context so the world can call them back naturally.
    • Standard conditions can affect checks. At 0 HP, death saves are server-rolled; recovery, rescue or a playable setback keeps the campaign going.
    • Health, spell slots, Second Wind, money, inventory, NPC attitudes, factions, routes, quests, durable facts and journal events carry forward.
    • Fighters can use Second Wind once and refresh it after a successful rest. Healing potions cannot be wasted at full health. Wizard Magic Missile damage is automatic and server-rolled.
    • Use /sheet, /map, /quests, /inventory, /journal or /recap for instant local information without spending a Groq turn.
    • Campaign tools can export a portable backup, keep three local save slots, read narration aloud and undo the last turn only when no dice, resource use, damage or healing revealed fate.
    • The display panel offers larger text, a readable sans-serif story font, focus reading and fullscreen. The app shell can also work offline after a successful load; AI turns still require a network connection.
    • Your campaign saves in this browser and is cryptographically signed by the server. A save expires after 30 days without a successful turn.
    • This remains a streamlined, solo, fifth-edition-inspired game rather than a complete tabletop simulator.
